setupNotes: Initial browser attempts used the wrong query parameter, then preceded preview gateway readiness. After the correct backend override and a listening gateway were verified, reload loaded 112 real source parcels and selection/details passed. These were local harness failures, not provider absence.
limitations: Manual local source wiring and parcel interaction verified. The independent topology audit covers the 90 polygons from the bounded qualification grid, not every polygon that a broader UI view may retrieve. Exact WUP point and municipality-wide completeness remain unverified.
